attributes.readMe:
## Publish Checklist (Cb)

The pre-publish gate, rendered. Four rows — photos (≥1 required, 10+ recommended), price set, description length (100+ chars recommended), address complete — each drawn as a pass ✓ / fail ✗ / warn ! glyph with the fact spelled out beside it, so an agent knows exactly what is between this listing and going live.

### Contract (render-only)

- `@model` — a structurally-typed bag of the facts it checks: `{ photoCount, askingPrice, description, address, cardTitle }`. Any object with those fields can be checked; the component never imports `PropertyListing`, so the same list works on a live card, a query row, or a plain draft object.
- `get ready(): boolean` — true when no row is a hard fail (warns don't block). Consumers that need the gate programmatically read this; the list itself renders regardless.
- `...attributes` ride onto the `<ul>` root for consumer styling.

### One definition, two readers

This list paints the SAME requirements `PublishListingCommand` enforces at write time — the command re-checks everything, so the checklist can never grant what the guard refuses. If the requirements move, they move in both places deliberately.

### Colour (boxel-theming)

Three published knobs — `--ck-pass-color`, `--ck-fail-color`, `--ck-warn-color` — defaulting to the theme's own state tokens (`--boxel-dark-green`, `--boxel-danger`, `--boxel-warning`). Glyph chips self-dilute via `color-mix(in oklab, …)`; zero hex literals.

### Non-goals

No blocking, no buttons, no toasts — the gate that refuses is the command's; this component only shows the agent the same list the guard will read.
